title: Tensor products, scalar extension and stalks of lisse sheaves of modules
statement:
Let $Y$ be a scheme with a geometric point $\bar y$, and let stalks at $\bar y$ be those of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. For a finite ring $\Lambda$ (not necessarily commutative), call a sheaf $\mathcal F$ of left $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] *lisse* if there are an etale covering $\{U_i\to Y\}$ and finite left $\Lambda$-modules $M_i$ with $\mathcal F|_{U_i}\cong\underline{M_i}_{U_i}$ as sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules, where $\underline M$ is the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the constant presheaf $U\mapsto M$.

1. *(Constant sheaves.)* For a ring $\Lambda$ and a $\Lambda$-module $M$, the map $M\to(\underline M)_{\bar y}$ sending $m$ to the germ of the global constant section $m$ is an isomorphism of $\Lambda$-modules.
2. *(Tensor products.)* Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative finite ring and $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ lisse sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules. The tensor product $\mathcal F\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal G$ (sheafification of $U\mapsto\mathcal F(U)\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal G(U)$) is lisse: on an etale $U$ where $\mathcal F|_U\cong\underline M$ and $\mathcal G|_U\cong\underline N$ one has $(\mathcal F\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal G)|_U\cong\underline{M\otimes_\Lambda N}$. The map $\mathcal F_{\bar y}\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal G_{\bar y}\to(\mathcal F\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal G)_{\bar y}$, $s_{\bar y}\otimes t_{\bar y}\mapsto(s\otimes t)_{\bar y}$, is an isomorphism, natural in $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ and compatible with the associativity, commutativity and unit isomorphisms on both sides.
3. *(Scalar extension.)* Let $\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be a homomorphism of finite rings and $\mathcal F$ a lisse sheaf of left $\Lambda$-modules. Then $\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal F$ (sheafification of $U\mapsto\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal F(U)$) is a lisse sheaf of left $\Lambda'$-modules, $(\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal F)|_U\cong\underline{\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda M}$ where $\mathcal F|_U\cong\underline M$, and $\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal F_{\bar y}\to(\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal F)_{\bar y}$, $\lambda'\otimes s_{\bar y}\mapsto(\lambda'\otimes s)_{\bar y}$, is an isomorphism of $\Lambda'$-modules, natural in $\mathcal F$ and compatible with composites $\Lambda\to\Lambda'\to\Lambda''$.

proof.text: The constant-sheaf stalk assertion is [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-geometric-stalk] applied to the underlying abelian group of $M$ (sheafification of a presheaf of $\Lambda$-modules has as underlying abelian sheaf the sheafification of the underlying presheaf of abelian groups, and the germ of the global constant section $m$ is the class of $\iota_Y(m)$ at $(Y,\bar y)$); $\Lambda$-linearity of $m\mapsto m_{\bar y}$ follows from the definitions.

Given trivializing coverings for $\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal G$, the fibre products $U_i\times_Y V_j$ form a common etale covering [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. On any etale $U$ with $\mathcal F|_U\cong\underline M$, $\mathcal G|_U\cong\underline N$, restriction to $U$ commutes with sheafification, and the presheaf tensor product of the two constant sheaves has the same sheafification as the constant presheaf $M\otimes_\Lambda N$ (Stacks 093V/095D), so $(\mathcal F\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal G)|_U\cong\underline{M\otimes_\Lambda N}$; likewise $(\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal F)|_U\cong\underline{\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda M}$ as sheaves of left $\Lambda'$-modules. Since $\Lambda,\Lambda'$ are finite, $M\otimes_\Lambda N$ and $\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda M$ are finite modules, which gives lissity.
Apply clause (1) of [lem-pod-etale-stalk-tensor-scalar] (commutative $\Lambda$, tensor product defined as the same sheafification) for the tensor-stalk isomorphism and its naturality and coherence.
The maps for composite scalar extensions agree on pure tensors by the associativity identification; this proves the coherence and naturality calculations.

Apply clause (2) of [lem-pod-etale-stalk-tensor-scalar], which holds for any (not necessarily commutative) ring homomorphism $\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ with $\Lambda'\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal F$ defined as the same sheafification, and gives the stated pure-germ formula, $\Lambda'$-linearity, naturality and compatibility with composites.

Lisse sheaves of Lambda-modules are the source predicate Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf at A = ModuleCat Lambda (the module-valued counterpart of def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves' set-valued IsLisseEtaleSheafOfSets; over a finite ring, local constancy as module sheaves with finitely generated stalks is the node's local finite constant values). Geometric points have IsAlgClosed fields; stalks are the fibres of (pointSmallEtale y).ulift.{u+1} and the tensor product is Sheaf.monoidalCategory, with the canonical Monoidal fibre instance, exactly as in lem-pod-etale-stalk-tensor-scalar. Stalk, naturality and coherence clauses carry the lisse hypotheses of the node. Scalar extension is ModuleCat.ringExtendScalars / Sheaf.ringExtendScalars of def-pod-ring-scalar-extension; its stalk comparison is the canonical inverse fibre comparison, pinned by the pure-germ formula b tensor a_y to (b tensor a)_y.
